support.reason: keeping a single key makes sense
Verified that nonstandard master key IDs remain backward compatible through testing
I don't see a good reason to have multiple keys or passphrases to encrypt the wallet going forward. And the corresponding code cleanup is necessary for long term wallet maintainability and usability.
From a high-level this change is safe: the worst that can happen is that some wallet edge case has not been taken into account and will fail to load on startup, which is fine.
